entries.titleZh: 阿夫迪伊夫卡战役 (2022年—2024年)

yearCorrection.reason: 维基数据 P585 精度为年代（2020s），索引条目因此记为 2020 年；中英文维基条目均记交火自 2022 年开始、2024 年 2 月 17 日乌军撤离，本条采用 2022–2024 年。

entries.summaryZh: 阿夫迪伊夫卡战役是俄乌战争中争夺顿涅茨克州阿夫迪伊夫卡城的战役。2022年俄军入侵后该市外围持续交火，2023年10月10日俄军发动攻势。该城是乌军经营多年的要塞，通往顿涅茨克的门户。2024年2月17日乌军为避免被围撤离，俄军取得2023年以来最大的一次领土推进。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Avdiivka was fought between Russian and Ukrainian forces for the city in Donetsk Oblast during the Russo-Ukrainian war. Fighting along its outskirts continued from 2022, and Russia launched a full offensive on 10 October 2023. Ukraine's commander-in-chief ordered a withdrawal on 17 February 2024 to avoid encirclement, giving Russia its largest gain since 2023.
entries.significanceZh: 俄军攻占这座乌军经营多年的要塞城市，是其2023年以来最大的一次领土推进，顿涅茨克方向的前线态势随之改变。
entries.significanceEn: The capture of one of Ukraine's most fortified cities gave Russia its largest territorial gain in months and reshaped the front line in Donetsk Oblast.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 精度为年代（2020s），结构化条目因此记为2020年；中英文维基百科均记交火自2022年开始、2024年2月17日乌军撤离，本条采用2022–2024年并在此保留该分歧。中文与英文维基百科均有该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 carries decade precision, so the index entry read 2020; both the Chinese and English Wikipedia articles date the fighting from 2022 to the Ukrainian withdrawal of 17 February 2024, which this entry adopts and the difference is recorded here. Wikipedia articles exist in both editions. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged from the structured record.

yearCorrection.reason: 维基数据 P585 精度为年代（2020s）；中文维基记2022年4月在克雷明纳的交战，英文条目（克雷明纳条目重定向至顿巴斯攻势）记攻势始于2022年4月18日。

entries.summaryZh: 克雷明纳战役是2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间顿巴斯攻势的第一场交战，2022年4月发生在卢甘斯克州克雷明纳。俄军自4月18日起沿东线推进，企图合围顿巴斯的乌军并占领顿涅茨克、卢甘斯克两州。克雷明纳的争夺被视为该攻势的开端，此后东线战事长期胶着。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Kreminna was the first engagement of Russia's Donbas offensive during the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, fought at Kreminna in Luhansk Oblast in April 2022. The offensive began on 18 April with the aim of encircling Ukrainian troops and taking the Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts. The fighting at Kreminna is treated as its opening phase.
entries.significanceZh: 它是俄军入侵第二阶段「顿巴斯攻势」的开端，此后东线战事转入长期消耗。
entries.significanceEn: It opened the second strategic phase of the invasion, the Donbas offensive, after which the eastern front settled into a war of attrition.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 精度为年代（2020s），索引条目记为2020年；中文维基百科记2022年4月的交战，英文维基百科的克雷明纳条目重定向至《顿巴斯攻势 (2022年)》，记攻势始于2022年4月18日，本条采用2022年。中英文维基百科均有该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 has decade precision, so the index entry read 2020; the Chinese Wikipedia article dates the fighting to April 2022, and the English Battle of Kreminna title redirects to Battle of Donbas (2022), which dates the offensive from 18 April 2022 - the year this entry adopts. Wikipedia articles exist in both editions. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 图卢兹战役是公元721年阿基坦公爵奥多率军击败围攻图卢兹的倭马亚军队的一战。安达卢斯总督萨姆赫·本·马利克·豪拉尼率倭马亚军队围城，奥多率阿基坦军队解围并将其击溃，萨姆赫阵亡。此役遏止了倭马亚势力自纳博讷向西进入阿基坦的扩张。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Toulouse (721) was a victory of an Aquitanian Christian army under Duke Odo the Great over the Umayyad force besieging Toulouse, commanded by al-Samh ibn Malik al-Khawlani, governor of al-Andalus. Odo relieved the city and routed the besiegers; al-Samh was killed. The victory checked the westward spread of Umayyad control from Narbonne into Aquitaine.
entries.significanceZh: 它是法兰克地区抵挡倭马亚扩张的关键胜利，使阿基坦在此后一段时间免于被纳入安达卢斯。
entries.significanceEn: It was a decisive check on Umayyad expansion beyond Narbonne and kept Aquitaine out of al-Andalus for the following years.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为721年6月9日，与英文维基条目正文一致，本条采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目（该条目的中文标签在中文维基百科没有对应页面）；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 9 June 721, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event (the Chinese label has no page there); the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 巴当山之战（又称巴多尼库斯山之战）是后罗马时期不列颠人与盎格鲁-撒克逊人的交战，传统上系于500年前后。据吉尔达斯约543至547年的记述，不列颠人取得重大胜利，暂时阻止了盎格鲁-撒克逊诸王国西进。9世纪《不列颠史》将指挥官亚瑟列入参战者，此战因而与亚瑟王传说相连。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Badon, also called Mons Badonicus, was purportedly fought between Britons and Anglo-Saxons in post-Roman Britain in the early sixth century. Gildas, writing around 543-547, credits the Britons with a major victory that halted the westward advance of the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms. The ninth-century Historia Brittonum names a commander called Arthur among the participants.
entries.significanceZh: 它被视为不列颠人阻止盎格鲁-撒克逊西进的关键胜利，也是亚瑟王传说最早的史事依托之一。
entries.significanceEn: It is remembered as the Britons' decisive check on Anglo-Saxon expansion and as one of the earliest historical anchors of the Arthurian legend.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 记为公元500年（年精度），但该战役的年代自古即不确定，英文维基正文将其置于6世纪初，并指出吉尔达斯约543至547年才提及此事，本条保留索引年并在正文中按6世纪初表述。中文维基百科尚无该条目（该条目的中文标签在中文维基百科没有对应页面）。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 500 CE at year precision, but the date has been uncertain since antiquity; the English article places the battle in the early sixth century and notes that Gildas wrote only around 543-547. The entry keeps the index year and says early sixth century in its text. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

yearCorrection.reason: 中英文维基条目均记为1614年11月26日；维基数据 P585 记为1600年12月26日，与该战役所属的大坂冬之阵（1614–1615年）矛盾，本条采用条目正文年份。

entries.summaryZh: 今福之战是1614年11月26日德川家康与丰臣氏在大坂冬之阵中的一场交战。家康派佐竹义宣率约1500人夺取大坂东北门户今福，守军约600人；佐竹军初战得手，丰臣方木村重成、后藤基次率援军反击，东军一度受挫，最终因上杉景胜等援军到达，丰臣军退回大坂城。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Imafuku was fought on 26 November 1614 between the forces of Tokugawa Ieyasu and the Toyotomi clan, one of the opening engagements of the winter campaign around Osaka. Ieyasu sent some 1,500 men under Satake Yoshinobu to seize the village; Toyotomi reinforcements counter-attacked, and only Uesugi Kagekatsu's arrival forced them back to Osaka castle.
entries.significanceZh: 它是大坂冬之阵的开局之战之一，确立了德川方在大坂外围的据点，为次年攻灭丰臣氏铺路。
entries.significanceEn: As one of the first battles of the winter campaign, it secured a Tokugawa foothold around Osaka and prepared the clan's destruction the following year.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 记为1600年12月26日，但中英文维基条目均记此战发生于1614年11月26日，且该战属1614至1615年的大坂冬之阵，故本条采用1614年并保留维基数据原值的矛盾（3.16报告曾因该矛盾暂缓升级此条）。中英文维基百科均有该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 26 December 1600, but both the Chinese and English Wikipedia articles date the battle to 26 November 1614, within the winter campaign of 1614-1615; the entry adopts 1614 and records the conflict with the source value, which is why the 3.16 round deferred this entity. Wikipedia articles exist in both editions. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 卡尔卡尔之战是公元前853年新亚述帝国与西亚诸国联军在卡尔卡尔的一场会战。亚述国王沙尔马那塞尔三世对阵由哈达德泽尔与以色列王亚哈等率领的十一国联军。此役参战人数超过以往任何战役，阿拉伯人等族群首次见于文献记载，战况刻于库尔赫石碑。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Qarqar was fought in 853 BC between the Neo-Assyrian army of Shalmaneser III and an allied force of eleven kings led by Hadadezer of Aram-Damascus and Ahab of Israel. It is notable for the number of combatants and for the first recorded appearance of peoples such as the Arabs, and is recorded on the Kurkh Monoliths.
entries.significanceZh: 它是古代西亚规模空前的会战，其铭文是亚述史料中最早记录阿拉伯人等族群的一次。
entries.significanceEn: It was the largest battle of its region up to that time and its inscription is the earliest Assyrian record naming peoples such as the Arabs.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为 ISO 天文纪年 −853（即公元前854年），而英文维基正文记该战役发生于公元前853年，另有据亚述名年官名录作公元前854年之说；本条按项目民用纪年惯例，以 −853 表示公元前853年，分歧已在此说明。中文维基百科尚无该条目（该条目的中文标签在中文维基百科没有对应页面）。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 is the ISO astronomical year -853 (854 BCE), while the English article dates the battle to 853 BC and notes that a different recension of the Assyrian Eponym List gives 854 BC; under the project's civil-year convention -853 means 853 BCE and the disagreement is recorded here. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 维苏威战役（蒙斯·拉克塔里乌斯之战）发生于552年10月，是哥特战争末期拜占庭与东哥特王国在维苏威火山附近的一次决战。东哥特国王托提拉在塔吉纳战死后，泰亚继位并率残部解库迈之围，被拜占庭将领纳尔西斯拦截。双方对峙两月后决战，泰亚阵亡，东哥特王国有组织的抵抗随之瓦解。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Mons Lactarius took place in October 552 during the Gothic War between Byzantine forces under Narses and the Ostrogoths near Mount Vesuvius. After King Totila's death at Taginae, his successor Teia marched to relieve Cumae and was intercepted; after two months of stalemate Teia was killed, ending organised Gothic royal leadership.
entries.significanceZh: 此役终结了东哥特王国的有组织抵抗，为拜占庭重新控制意大利铺平道路。
entries.significanceEn: It ended organised Ostrogothic resistance and cleared the way for the Byzantine reconquest of Italy.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为552年10月（月精度），与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目（该条目的中文标签在中文维基百科没有对应页面）；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 gives October 552 at month precision, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event (the Chinese label has no page there); the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 塔吉纳战役（又称布斯塔·加洛鲁姆之战）发生于552年7月，是哥特战争后期拜占庭将领纳尔西斯与东哥特国王托提拉之间的决战。纳尔西斯自达尔马提亚沿亚得里亚海岸进入意大利，与托提拉在塔吉纳交锋。托提拉战死，东哥特王国就此瓦解，拜占庭得以重新征服意大利半岛。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Taginae, also called Busta Gallorum, was fought in July 552 between the Byzantines under Narses and the Ostrogoths under King Totila in the late stage of the Gothic War. Narses marched from Dalmatia into Italy; Totila was killed and the Gothic kingdom dissolved, opening the way for the Byzantine reconquest of the peninsula.
entries.significanceZh: 托提拉之死与东哥特主力的覆灭，使拜占庭得以在意大利重建统治。
entries.significanceEn: The death of Totila and the destruction of the Gothic field army allowed Byzantium to re-establish its rule in Italy.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为552年7月（月精度），与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目（该条目的中文标签在中文维基百科没有对应页面）；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 gives July 552 at month precision, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event (the Chinese label has no page there); the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 1148年围攻大马士革发生于7月24日至28日，是第二次十字军东征期间的一次攻城战。法兰西国王路易七世、罗马人的国王康拉德三世与耶路撒冷王国的军队联合围攻塞尔柱势力控制的大马士革，最终被击退。此役失败使十字军国家与当地穆斯林盟友的关系破裂。
entries.summaryEn: The siege of Damascus took place between 24 and 28 July 1148 during the Second Crusade. Armies led by Louis VII of France and Conrad III of Germany joined the Kingdom of Jerusalem in attacking the Seljuk-held city, and the effort ended in a Crusader defeat. The failure broke Jerusalem's alliance with Damascus and helped seal the crusade's collapse.
entries.significanceZh: 它是第二次十字军东征由盛转衰的转折点，也破坏了耶路撒冷王国在大马士革方向的盟友关系。
entries.significanceEn: It marked the failure of the Second Crusade and destroyed the Kingdom of Jerusalem's alliance with Damascus.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1148年7月28日；英文维基正文记围攻自7月24日至28日（旧历），条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目（该条目的中文标签在中文维基百科没有对应页面）；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 28 July 1148; the English article dates the siege from 24 to 28 July (Old Style) and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event (the Chinese label has no page there); the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 蒙斯战役是1914年8月23日第一次世界大战中英国远征军的首次大规模交战，属边境战役的一部分。英军试图守住蒙斯—孔代运河一线，抵挡德军第一集团军推进。英军以寡敌众，给对手造成不成比例的伤亡，但因兵力劣势与法军第五集团军撤退暴露右翼，被迫后撤。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Mons was the first major engagement of the British Expeditionary Force in the First World War, fought on 23 August 1914 as part of the Battle of the Frontiers. The British tried to hold the Mons-Conde canal; outnumbered, and with their right flank exposed by the French retreat, they were forced to withdraw.
entries.significanceZh: 此役是英国远征军的首战，其阻击与随后的撤退成为一战初期西线机动作战的标志性事件。
entries.significanceEn: It was the BEF's baptism of fire and its fighting retreat set the pattern of the opening mobile phase on the Western Front.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1914年8月23日，与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目（该条目的中文标签在中文维基百科没有对应页面）；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 23 August 1914, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event (the Chinese label has no page there); the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.
